import json, asyncio, httpx, openai
from openai import OpenAI, AsyncOpenAI, DefaultHttpxClient, DefaultAsyncHttpxClient
BODY={"id":"c1","object":"chat.completion","created":1,"model":"gpt-4o","choices":[{"index":0,"finish_reason":"stop","message":{"role":"assistant","content":"hi there"}}]}
seen=[]
def h(req):
    seen.append((req.method,str(req.url),json.loads(req.content)["model"],req.headers["authorization"]))
    return httpx.Response(200,json=BODY)
# default construction (no http_client) must work
d=OpenAI(api_key="k"); assert isinstance(d._client, httpx.Client); d.close()
c=OpenAI(api_key="k",base_url="http://x/v1",http_client=DefaultHttpxClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(h)))
r=c.chat.completions.create(model="gpt-4o",messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
assert r.choices[0].message.content=="hi there", r
assert seen[0]==("POST","http://x/v1/chat/completions","gpt-4o","Bearer k"), seen
async def main():
    a0=AsyncOpenAI(api_key="k"); await a0.close()
    a=AsyncOpenAI(api_key="k",base_url="http://x/v1",http_client=DefaultAsyncHttpxClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(h)))
    r=await a.chat.completions.create(model="gpt-4o",messages=[{"role":"user","content":"yo"}])
    assert r.choices[0].message.content=="hi there"
asyncio.run(main())
assert len(seen)==2
print("OK", httpx.__version__, openai.__version__)
control.notes: openai 1.56.1 passes proxies= to httpx.Client only when proxies is given directly to the internal SyncAPIClient/AsyncAPIClient constructors (_base_client.py lines 819-820 and 1402-1403). The public OpenAI/AsyncOpenAI classes never forward it, so users can't reach that code. The CLI already uses mounts= with HTTPTransport(proxy=...). No use of app=, cert= or the module-level request helpers was found. Default and custom http_client construction plus sync and async chat completions all work on httpx 0.28.0. Remaining risk: code that subclasses the internal base client and passes proxies= itself would get a TypeError on httpx 0.28; that is not public API.
